meta.title: Auto Range | Land Rover & Range Rover Specialists
meta.description: Auto Range is a Land Rover and Range Rover service center: scheduled maintenance, dealer-level diagnostics, air suspension and genuine parts, with fast booking and live job tracking.

home.lead: Precise servicing with dealer-grade diagnostics, genuine parts with warranty, and booking in a minute with step-by-step updates on your car.

services.title: Everything your car needs, under one roof
services.lead: From scheduled servicing to the trickiest electrical and air-suspension faults, by a team that works on Land Rover only.

why.title: Real specialists, not just a claim
why.lead: We work on Land Rover and Range Rover only, so we know their common faults and the right fix the first time.

specialist.title: One-brand specialists
specialist.body: Technicians trained on Land Rover systems and updates.

tools.title: Dealer-grade equipment
tools.body: Module diagnostics and programming instead of guessing parts.

transparent.title: Clear price up front
transparent.body: A written report and a cost you approve before any repair.

onTime.title: On-time handover
onTime.body: We set a ready date and tell you right away if anything changes.

book.title: Book online
book.body: Pick the service and a time slot in under a minute.

diagnose.body: We check the car and send the report to your WhatsApp.

approve.title: You approve first
approve.body: No repair starts until you approve the cost.

track.title: Track and collect
track.body: Follow your car's status with your booking code until it's ready.

models.lead: Pick your model to see the parts that fit it.

cta.title: Ready to book a service?

about.title: A workshop built around one car
about.lead: Auto Range is an independent Land Rover and Range Rover specialist, founded by technicians who spent years on these cars in particular.

story.title: Our story
story.p1: We started because Land Rover owners had two choices: a dealer with high prices and long waits, or a general garage working by guesswork.
story.p2: We set out to be the third option: dealer-level know-how and equipment, with transparency, fair prices and personal attention for every car.
story.p3: Today we look after the whole Land Rover family, from Evoque to Defender, and keep every customer updated until they collect their car.

craft.title: Craft
craft.body: We fix the real cause of a fault, not just the symptom.

honesty.title: Clarity
honesty.body: You know the diagnosis and the cost before we start. No surprises at collection.

respect.title: Your time matters
respect.body: A fixed appointment, regular updates and handover when we said.

longevity.title: A longer life for your car
longevity.body: Genuine parts and preventive care that protect your car's value.

contact.title: We're here to help
contact.lead: Call or WhatsApp us for the fastest reply, or leave a message and we'll get back to you.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: We collect only what we need to serve you, and we never sell it.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: When you book, request parts or message us, we store your name, mobile number, car details and any notes you write. Your parts request list stays on your device until you send it.

use.title: How we use it
use.body: To confirm appointments, answer your questions and show your car's status on the tracking page. We don't send marketing messages without your consent.

share.title: Who we share it with
share.body: Only the service providers needed to run the site (hosting and database), or a competent legal authority when required.

keep.title: How long we keep it
keep.body: We keep booking records to follow your car's service history and warranty. You can ask us to delete them at any time.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can ask for a copy of your data, or for it to be corrected or deleted, by phone, WhatsApp or email.
